## History

During the preparations for Miss Lavendar's wedding, Fred Wright and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) fall in love. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally discovers their feelings for one another, after which [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to confide the details of her engagement to Fred.

_Sources: [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P0](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0000), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P5](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0005), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P15](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0015)_

## Relationships

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/fred-wright--gilbert-blythe.md)

Fred Wright and [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) are fellow members of the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers). Together with the rest of the group, they work on local community projects such as raising funds to paint the village hall and addressing unwanted advertisements in the area.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P0](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0000), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P10](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0010), +9 more_

- Comrade of — fellow Village Improvement Society members  <sub>[v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P10](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0010), [v2 IX A Question of Color P28](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0028)</sub>
